compareDisposition.rationale: The curator examined Covenant joins descendants and land beside Abram leaves and receives a land promise; Promise passes through affliction and return; Isaac is told to remain in the land; Bethel joins exile-bound flight to promised return. Those passages share its Eden-and-exile evidence group or canonical movement, but none supplies a distinct two-source relationship stronger than the accepted comparisons already carrying this topic.
